messages:
emma: quick follow-up from today's GPU saturation postmortem. we have 4 concrete follow-ups: tenant burst cushion, scheduler hysteresis, nightly job gating, headroom reserve. need owners + dates.

raj: i'll take scheduler hysteresis + measurements. plan: replay baseline, test coalesce=90ms and eviction_hysteresis=4%. will post results in 48h.

danielle: i'll own tenant burst cushion (elastic cushion 10% for 90s then 6m decay). RFC + unit tests by 2026-04-07.

marco: headroom + telemetry here. propose static reserve 4% + ephemeral surge 8% drained over 10m. will add fallback_event_id to usage stream. draft by 2026-03-31.

infra-bot: Created issue infra/ops#1830 "elastic-cushion + scheduler-hysteresis" (assignee: danielle).

emma: gating nightly compaction at ~02:40 UTC is high priority. can the job-runner preflight when global_headroom < 12% and randomize delay 2-6m?

raj: yes. i'll include a preflight check in the scheduler changes. PR scoped.

danielle: calendar: "GPU capacity follow-up" weekly 15m starting 2026-03-26 09:00 PDT. rotating infra oncall. invite out.

marco: measurement targets: eviction_count down >=30% and p99 delta <8%. will attach replay CSVs to infra/ops#1830. due 2026-03-29.

emma: runbook updates + notif template once first PR lands. mira from support wants a short customer note template for tenants hit by fallback.

infra-bot: Reminder: issue infra/ops#1830 assigned to danielle - due 2026-04-07.

raj: quick note: observed backup sweep at 02:35 UTC in traces. gating should mitigate overlap. adding a dashboard panel for 02:00-04:00 UTC headroom drop.

marco: i'll add telemetry field `degraded_mode=true` to tenant exports and include billing annotation.

danielle: PR timeline: RFC + tests by 2026-04-07; gating coord with batch team by 2026-04-02.

emma: summary: short-term (1-2w) = cushion + preflight gating + small scheduler nudges; medium-term (3-6w) = scheduler PR and automated degraded routing. weekly triage for 6 weeks then reduce if stable. ping here when PRs land. :white_check_mark:
